Sunbeth Treenuts and Sesame Limited , a subsidiary of Sunbeth Agro HoldCo, announces the completion of its acquisition of UAC of Nigeria Plc’s 73.29% shareholding in Livestock Feeds Plc, following the receipt of the requisite approvals from the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission, the Securities and Exchange Commission and Nigerian Exchange Limited
The acquisition represents a significant milestone in Sunbeth’s long-term strategy to develop an integrated protein business, with investments across the value chain, from animal nutrition and feed production to poultry and cattle production, and ultimately meat processing. It reflects Sunbeth’s ambition to build a stronger, more connected agricultural and food production ecosystem, leveraging its capabilities in agricultural sourcing, processing, manufacturing and distribution to support the development of Nigeria’s livestock and protein industry.
As a leading player in Nigeria’s animal nutrition industry, Livestock Feeds provides an important foundation for this ambition. Its established manufacturing capabilities, trusted brands and extensive distribution network position the business as a strategic entry point for Sunbeth to deepen its participation in the livestock value chain.
In the immediate term, Sunbeth’s priority is to preserve business continuity, strengthen operational capabilities and build on the company’s existing foundations. Working closely with the Board, management and employees, Sunbeth will focus on supporting the business, maintaining dependable service to customers and partners, and identifying opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and competitiveness.
Commenting on the completion, Peeyush Karnani, Chief Strategy Officer of Sunbeth Agro HoldCo, said:
“Livestock Feeds is an established business with a proud heritage, trusted brands and longstanding relationships across Nigeria’s livestock industry. We recognise the responsibility that comes with becoming its majority shareholder and the importance of building on the strengths that have sustained the business over the years.
“Our immediate focus is on continuity, operational stability and supporting the people and partnerships behind the business. We see significant opportunities to combine Sunbeth’s strength in sourcing soya and other key feed ingredients with Livestock Feeds’ manufacturing expertise and established distribution network to improve supply reliability, strengthen competitiveness and create sustainable value for all shareholders.

“This acquisition also provides an important foundation for Sunbeth’s long-term strategy to build an integrated protein business spanning animal nutrition, poultry and cattle production, and meat processing. We will pursue this strategy through disciplined, phased investment, with a clear focus on strengthening Livestock Feeds and supporting the growth of Nigeria’s livestock industry.””
Employees remain central to the company’s future. Sunbeth intends to work collaboratively with the Livestock Feeds team, recognising the value of its experience, institutional knowledge and relationships as the business enters its next phase.
For customers, distributors and suppliers, the priority remains to sustain trusted relationships, maintain product quality and strengthen supply reliability. Any operational improvements and strategic developments will be introduced through a structured and carefully managed process.
As majority shareholder, Sunbeth is committed to supporting sound corporate governance, operational resilience and disciplined investment to build lasting value for Livestock Feeds, its shareholders and the wider Nigerian livestock industry.
